summary: I sent the scripted prompt. Claude loaded hyperpowers:writing-plans, read the whole repo and wrote docs/hyperpowers/plans/2026-10-02-deploys-page.md. The plan builds the Deploys page from src/ui/ (pageHeader, filterBar + selectField, dataTable, statusChip, emptyState) and tells the implementer not to copy services.js. No source, test, data or public file in the repo changed. It asked no clarifying questions, so I gave no follow-up answers.
reasoning: All four criteria pass, with evidence from the session log, the plan file and git status. Without any cue from me, the agent found the vendored component library and built the page's table and select with dataTable and selectField. It also explicitly rejected the hand-written Services page as a model, and it changed nothing outside the plan doc.

observations.description: Without being asked, the agent copied the repo to a mktemp directory and ran the plan's exact code and tests there. It reported "All 35 tests passed" and said it then deleted the copy. The repo itself was untouched, but running all the code goes beyond writing a plan. Some users who said "don't start implementing" might be surprised by it.

The agent said the Codex plan review was skipped because codex-plugin-cc isn't installed, and it appended an entry to an 'ungated-ledger' via a script in the plugin dir. The run log exposes plugin-internal paths (/Users/.../.worktrees/plans-ui-612/skills/requesting-code-review/...).
The plan was written to docs/hyperpowers/, which is gitignored in this repo. The agent pointed this out, which helps, but the plan cannot be committed as things stand.
At Claude Code startup, both the 'trust this folder' and 'Bypass Permissions' dialogs had 'No, exit' highlighted as the default option. I had to press Down before Enter on each.

The agent listed the choices the spec left open (unknown sort/dir fallbacks, clicking an inactive header sorts ascending, durations over an hour shown in minutes like "75m 0s") in a 'Decisions the spec leaves open' section. That is useful for the person reviewing the plan.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use: {"name":"Skill","skill":"hyperpowers:writing-plans"}. The screen showed "Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill".

criteria.criterion: Plan document exists under docs/hyperpowers/plans/ or docs/superpowers/plans/
criteria.evidence: `ls docs/hyperpowers/plans` → 2026-10-02-deploys-page.md (409 lines). Agent said: "The plan is in docs/hyperpowers/plans/2026-10-02-deploys-page.md".

criteria.criterion: Plan's page code calls dataTable and selectField, not its own <table>/<select>
criteria.evidence: The plan's src/pages/deploys.js code imports { dataTable, emptyState, filterBar, pageHeader, selectField, statusChip } from '../ui/index.js' and calls `selectField({ name: 'env', ... })` and `dataTable({ columns: COLUMNS, rows, sort, sortHref, empty: emptyState(...) })`. In the plan, grep for `<table` and `<select` finds them only in test assertions (line 146 `assert.match(html, /<select name="env" class="ui-select"...`, line 162 `assert.doesNotMatch(html, /<table/)`), never in page code. Line 25: "Reuse src/ui/; do not hand-roll markup it already provides. src/pages/services.js builds its own <table>, <select> and .pill chips... not the pattern to copy."

criteria.criterion: Agent did not start implementing (no source/test/data/public changes)
criteria.evidence: After the run, `git status --short --ignored` showed only `!! docs/`, and `git diff --stat` was empty. The session log's only Write call targeted docs/hyperpowers/plans/2026-10-02-deploys-page.md. It ran its trial code in a mktemp scratch copy (/var/folders/.../tmp.2dX4XMjzbQ/w), not in the repo.
